name: mibao-media-archivist
description: Persistent media inventory, incremental indexing, evidence-linked search and compatible delivery with originals preserved.

displayDescription.zh: 保护照片视频原件，持续盘点多盘媒体，保留副本位置与人工标注，支持中文片段检索、断点续跑和交付验收
displayDescription.en: Preserve original media, maintain multi-source inventories and annotations, search Chinese text and timecoded segments, resume work and verify delivery.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一批照片、手机视频和DV录像，请直接帮我整理并交付结果
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have photos, phone videos, and DV recordings. Process them and deliver the results directly.

quickPrompts.en: I have photos, phone videos, and DV recordings. Process them and deliver the results directly.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一批照片、手机视频和DV录像，请直接帮我整理并交付结果

quickPrompts.en: Convert these videos to a playable format and deliver proxies, an inventory, thumbnails, and a processing report.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这批视频转成可播放格式，并生成清单、缩略图和处理报告

quickPrompts.en: Index this historical broadcast archive and search by people, places, dialogue, and timecodes.
quickPrompts.zh: 为电视台历史影像建立索引，按人物、地点、台词和时间码直接搜出结果
